nodes.title: Soul Person Enhance
widgets_values:
# Soul Person Enhance

**Enhance each person in a photo on her own — or only the ones you pick.**

Upscale a group portrait as a whole and every face gets a tiny slice of the
model's attention: whoever is in the back stays blurry, whoever is in front
gets plastic skin.

Here each person is **cropped**, enhanced **alone** at full size, and put back
at the exact pixel she came from, with the edge melted into the scene.

## How to use

1. **Photo** — load the image.
2. **Pick people?** — on, only the marked people are treated.
   Off, it treats **everyone** SAM3 can find.
3. **canvas** — left click marks who you want.
   Shift or right click marks who should be left out.
4. **size** — side of the crop handed to the model. 768 is a good default.
5. **Run**.

The `who got picked` panel shows the boxes drawn over the photo: that is how
you check the click caught the right person.

## The settings that matter

| setting | what it does |
|---|---|
| `size` | side of the crop. Bigger = more real pixels handed to the model |
| `padding` | room around the person, so hair and feet are not clipped |
| `min_area` | ignores a blob too small to be a person |
| `max_people` | 0 = everyone; any other number keeps the N largest |

## Swapping the enhance model

The enhance lives in its own subgraph (`Ups_OP_01`). The crop and merge nodes
neither know nor care what is inside it — swap in Qwen, Z-Image, SDXL,
whatever you prefer.
